method: Complete current server runner implementation isolated by removing imports/export modifiers, transpiled with installed Bun, evaluated with synthetic adapter only. Invoked with --no-env-file. No live module, environment file, database, provider, browser or network import.

outcomes.message: Canned response insertion is composer-controlled — server runner does not auto-send.
Team assignment runs server-side in Phase 8.

limits: Proves the current runner loop and result aggregation for two synthetic action sequences only.
Does not prove actual production invocation, authorization bypass, database transaction behavior, browser behavior or provider delivery.
No D24 proposed plan, composite admission, RLS or rollback implementation exists or was tested.
Synthetic status/step labels are legacy runner inputs, not acceptance of the future D24 action vocabulary.
